reason: The cited evidence directly shows γ/γ′ interfaces pinning dislocations (E1) and blocking atomic transport (E2), supporting the core barrier mechanism. However, the evidence compares HESA (with precipitates) to HEA, not multilayer to homogeneous coatings, so the premise that a multilayer architecture replicates this effect is an extrapolation without direct support.
premises: γ/γ′ interfaces in HEAs hinder dislocation motion
Multilayer architecture introduces such coherent interfaces
Homogeneous HEA coatings lack these engineered barriers
